title: Adjust relevance score for new embedding model
summary: Relevance score thresholds for item search have been adjusted to work with a new embedding model that returns different score ranges, making more relevant items appear in search results with appropriate confidence levels.
key_points: Minimum context-aware ranking score lowered from 0.70 to 0.25 in Sales Lines Suggestions
Confidence thresholds (High/Medium/Low) significantly reduced in both Sales Lines Suggestions and Create Product Information apps
Comparison operators changed from greater-than to greater-than-or-equal for consistency
Changes optimize results for new embedding model while maintaining confidence categorization
No API, schema or permission changes; behavior adapts to new model's scoring distribution
